title: 5 Thai Phrases That Will Change Your Trip to Thailand
description: Master 5 essential Thai phrases that will transform your trip to Thailand! Learn how to order food, greet locals, and navigate daily situations like a pro. Perfect for first-time visitors and travel enthusiasts.

phrases_taught.thai: สวัสดีค่ะ / สวัสดีครับ
ขอบคุณมากๆ ค่ะ/ครับ
เท่าไหร่ครับ?

learning_outcomes: Understand Thai politeness particles (ค่ะ/ครับ)
Master proper pronunciation of essential phrases
Learn cultural context for using these phrases
Apply phrases in real-world Thai situations
target_audience: Thai language beginners, travelers, first-time visitors to Thailand
